Title: View profile page after successful login
Preconditions: User is logged in with a valid session token
Steps:
Given Given the user is on the dashboard page
When When the user clicks the profile icon in the header
When Then the profile page is displayed
Then And the user's name, email, and profile picture are visible
Expected Result: Profile page loads within 2 seconds and displays correct user data

Title: Edit profile with valid data and save
Preconditions: User is on the profile page with editable fields
Steps:
Given Given the user is on the profile page
When When the user clicks "Edit" and changes the display name to "John Doe"
When And updates the bio to "Software engineer at Acme Corp."
When And clicks "Save"
When Then a success toast "Profile updated" appears
Then And the new name and bio are displayed
Expected Result: Profile updates persist and are shown immediately

Title: Attempt to save profile with empty required name field
Preconditions: User is on the profile page in edit mode
Steps:
Given Given the user is editing the profile
When When the user clears the display name field
When And clicks "Save"
When Then an inline error "Name is required" is shown next to the field
Then And the profile is not updated

When When the user presses the browser back button
When Then the previous page (e.g., dashboard) is displayed
Then And the profile page reloads with updated data when navigated forward again

When When 60 seconds pass without activity
When And the user clicks "Save"
When Then a modal "Session expired" appears
Then And the user is redirected to the login page
Expected Result: Session timeout handled gracefully during edit
